document.text:
Orrin's Bakehouse - Sourdough Starter Care

Orrin's Bakehouse sells a live rye starter that it has kept since 1987. Each jar holds about 120 grams of starter.

Feed the starter once a day at room temperature. The bakehouse recommends its own flour blend, sold as Graywick No. 9, mixed one to one with water by weight.

A starter kept in the fridge needs feeding once a week. Orrin's replaces a starter that dies in the first month at no charge.
